visualReview.notes: Inspected seven current portable views. The facade reads with its two copper-topped brick towers, deep pointed limestone arch, paired arched lower windows, copper corner domes, and dark entry canopy. The rear volumes step with the mapped building outline.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected seven current shared-material views, including the dated North Laurel Street placement. Brick, pale limestone and trim, copper roofs, blue glazed panels and dark metal remain distinct. The placement view includes the stepped rear and the separate front tower and dome profiles.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected 23 current context, detail and transition frames. The two towers, corner pavilions, entrance recess, auditorium and stage masses persist across all four levels. Nearer levels restore the window trim, cornices, copper lantern detail and terracotta surround.

geographicReview.notes: The outer envelope follows the 24 mapped corners of OpenStreetMap way 229623395. North Laurel Street fixes the front orientation. The dedicated view on the original unmasked field shows the continuous limestone base at the sampled street grade. Exact threshold and footing depths remain approximate.

fidelityReview.scope: The Altria Theater exterior at 6 North Laurel Street as photographed in June 2023. Includes the mapped building, brick and terracotta front, recessed pointed arch, paired slender towers, corner pavilion roof forms and main auditorium envelope. Theater interiors, temporary objects, vehicles and streets are outside the model.
fidelityReview.notes: The June 2023 images establish the brick and light trim rhythm, copper towers and pavilion caps, pointed arch and dark canopy. Exact height, rear and roof sections and hidden details are estimates. A dated 2023 appearance supplies placement evidence.

imageryReview.notes: Two published Qualla originals by MonkeyBBGB matched the exact Commons SHA-1, pinned file records and explicit photographer CC0 dedications. Only architectural details were used. The older hero photo was excluded because its credit differs from the original upload attribution.

validation.sharedCaptureScope: June 2023 North Laurel Street theater exterior, paired towers and mapped auditorium envelope

limitations: Two verified Qualla CC0 street photographs establish the Laurel Street façade as documented on 2023-06-07. The tall pointed entrance recess, tower shafts and copper lanterns, window pairs and bands, limestone street base, and brick wing and corner pavilion are modeled from visible proportions.

The mapped boundary fixes the plan envelope. Rear roof, stage mass, exact building and tower elevations, and details screened from the street are medium-fi estimates. Only the June 2023 exterior is represented.
The original 128 m DEM field is unchanged. Source ground near the Laurel Street entrance supplies Y=0. Foundation, threshold and grade remain approximate.
The model contains original geometry and shared procedural materials. Foreground objects, branded signage, surrounding sites and interior features are outside its scope.
